verdict.rationale: Notion's own site directly claims the core of this story: AI answers delivered instantly with citations. The evidence is a single marketing line, and the MCP search and Agent API items are developer-facing, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the AI Q&A feature, explicit confirmation that citations point to workspace pages and connected sources, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality and citation accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content
